title: Microsoft's new gaming CEO Asha Sharma teases the next Xbox, codenamed Project Helix, saying it "will lead in performance and play your Xbox and PC games" (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Microsoft's new gaming CEO Asha Sharma teases the next Xbox, codenamed Project Helix, saying it “will lead in performance and play your Xbox and PC games” — The new Xbox boss Asha Sharma revealed the codename as one of her first big announcements.
